transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical issue. After yesterday's full-site rehearsal, I completed an RF survey and found that audience handheld microphones interfere with the emergency-communications channel. The approved workaround is a host-led call-and-response using exactly two wired microphones instead. I should note my written survey has not yet been filed with the event office, but the findings are conclusive and the workaround has been approved.

transcript.text: I need to present my rights clearance report now. I received the publisher's final clearance email this morning, and I have to flag two critical issues. First, only two of the four selected songs are actually licensed for the finale — 'Afterglow' and 'Northbound'. The other two songs are not cleared. Second, the license expressly prohibits projected lyrics, which directly conflicts with the draft package's plan to have the audience read projected lyrics. I have not yet entered this email into the festival rights register, but the publisher's terms are final and binding.
